title: Aeneas restored; the Greek line holds
intro: Aeneas returns; the Greeks hold their ground. Vocabulary and forms follow the Greek in reading order.

notes.text: “Brought the force of their hands straight forward”; ἰθύς adv., straight ahead; φέρον = ἔφερον, 3pl impf.
“Spread [night] around the battle”; ἀμφί separated from the verb; μάχῃ dat sg.
Rushing, impetuous; epithet of Ares.
“Helping the Trojans”; ἀρήγω + dat; pres act ptc nom sg; Τρώεσσιν = Τρωσί.
“Going everywhere”; πάντοσε, in every direction; ἐποίχομαι, range over / go about; pres mid ptc.
κραίνω, fulfil: 3sg impf, epic expanded form. ἐφετμή, command: acc pl.
χρυσάορος, golden-sworded; gen sg with Ἀπόλλωνος; ἄορ = sword.
ἄνωγα, command; past indicative here. ἐγεῖραι: aor act inf of ἐγείρω, rouse; θυμόν its object.
εἶδον, see: unaugmented 3sg aor; οἴχομαι, be gone: pres mid ptc acc fem sg with Athena. “Saw that Athena had departed.”
πέλω, be: unaugmented 3sg impf. ἀρηγών, helper (nom sg), + dat Δαναοῖσιν.
πίων, rich / well-endowed (literally fat): gen sg. ἄδυτον, inner sanctuary: epic gen sg -οιο.
ἵημι, send forth: 3sg aor act. βάλλω, put / cast: unaugmented 3sg 2aor; “put strength in his breast.”
στῆθος, breast: dat pl. ποιμήν, shepherd: dat sg; “shepherd of the host,” Aeneas.
μεθίστημι, take one's place among: unaugmented 3sg impf mid; ἑτάροισι dat pl, companions.
τοί = οἱ, “they”; χαίρω, rejoice: 3pl aor pass in form, intransitive in sense.
Alive; unhurt / sound. ἀρτεμής: acc masc sg, uncontracted -έα; both describe Aeneas.
πρόσειμι (εἶμι, go), approach: pres ptc acc masc sg; “coming towards them.”
ἐσθλός, good / strong. μεταλλάω, question / inquire: unaugmented 3pl aor act. γε μὲν οὔ τι: “but they did not question him at all.”
ἐάω, allow: 3sg impf, “did not allow [them to ask].” πόνος: toil, here battle's pressing work.
Silver-bowed (Apollo); mortal-destroying (Ares): βροτός + λοιγός, destruction.
“Raging insatiably”; ἄμοτον adv.; μέμονα, be eager: perf act ptc nom fem sg (masc μεμαώς), with Ἔρις.
The two Ajaxes: nom dual. ὀτρύνω, urge on: unaugmented 3pl impf.
πολεμίζω, fight: epic pres act inf -έμεν = -ειν.
ὑποδείδω, shrink in fear before: 3pl plup with impf sense. ἰωκή, pursuit / onrush: acc pl.
“Like clouds”; νεφέλη dat pl; ἔοικα, resemble: perf act ptc nom masc pl + dat.
νηνεμίη, still air: gen sg, “in a calm.” ἵστημι: 3sg transitive aor, “set [the clouds].”
“On lofty mountains”; dat pl, ὄρος neuter. ἀτρέμας adv., motionless.
“While [the wind's force] sleeps”; εὕδω, 3sg pres subj, epic -ῃσι = -ῃ. Βορέαο: gen sg of Βορέας, north wind.
ζαχρεῖος, violent: gen pl. σκιόεις, shadowy / dark: acc neut pl with νέφεα.
“With shrill blasts”; πνοιή + λιγυρός, dat fem pl.
διασκίδνημι, scatter: 3pl pres act; ἄημι, blow: pres act ptc nom masc pl.
ἔμπεδον adv., firmly / without moving. φέβομαι, flee in fear: 3pl impf; “did not give way.”
“Went to and fro through the throng”; ἀνά + acc; φοιτάω, 3sg impf.
“Be men”; ἀνέρες = ἄνδρες; ἔστε 2pl pres imperative of εἰμί.
“Take courage”; ἄλκιμος, stout / brave; ἦτορ, heart (neut). αἱρέω: 2pl 2aor mid imperative, stem ἑλ-.
αἰδέομαι, respect / feel shame before: 2pl pres mid imperative, + acc ἀλλήλους. ὑσμίνη, battle: acc pl.
“Among men who respect [one another], more survive”; gen pl, partitive; σόος = σῶς, safe / alive.
“Than have been killed”; ἠέ = ἤ. πέφανται: 3pl perf pass, slay-root φεν-/φαν- (πέφνω), not φαίνω.
“Renown arises”; ὄρνυμαι, 3sg pres mid. ἀλκή, strength / effective defence. φευγόντων: “for those who flee.”
